title: Chocolate Avocado Pudding
summary: This chocolate avocado pudding comes together with just 5 ingredients in 5 minutes for a silky, chocolatey treat with no added sugar.
steps: Soak dates in warm water for at least 30 minutes. Drain and be sure to remove the pits.
Add all the ingredients into a food processor or blender and blend until smooth, scraping down the sides as needed.
Taste and add more cocoa powder or dates (or other sweeteners like maple syrup or honey) as desired. Enjoy cold with toppings of choice, if desired.
